Phaaah... this udon hits the spot...!
...Thanks, even making me food and all... You've really helped me out.
Then... let's see, close your eyes.

When I found Mr. C.B. around town, she wasn't feeling well. She insisted
it was nothing serious, so I decided to at least take her back home.

But to me, that track isn't meant for that.
It exists simply to be run on. That's all there is to it.

Still, no matter what... Which race to win for what honor,
or how many times you have to win something to be amazing...
...Ahaha, what do you know. ...I guess that's how it is, yeah.

Everyone around surges ahead in a flash—don't lose the heat, catch the frontrunner!
Dig your heels in again with everything you've got, quick short breaths, in and out—

It seemed like an easy issue to solve
if both sides could simply reach a compromise, but...
...Back in the day, you know.

"Your strength truly shines when front-running."
"Let's learn various running styles so you can handle any situation."
...Mm, no. I was just surprised.

Hehe, somehow I'm the one getting the urge to run now.
So... how was it? Well?

Lined up beside you are nearly ten elite Umamusume. Rudolf,
Ace... all girls who look like they'd make for a thrilling race.

Wouldn't it be enough if I could simply
love racing just as purely as she does?

I just couldn't bring myself to care about stuff like that from the bottom of my heart.
And so—

No, I'm fine.
This kind of feeling goes away if I just sleep it off... *cough*

Still... I like it. Yeah, not bad. Not bad at all.
Let's give it a shot!

I wondered if I could love racing as much as she does, but...
perhaps that was a conceited suggestion on my part.
You run!

You're not in the mood for that.
Let's see... let's swing to the very back and watch the race unfold from the rear.
...That alone is the purest bliss.

Wanting to see people smile, wanting to hype things up... I get that
those are wonderful things too, honestly.

Her tone was gentle, fervent, and brimming with love.
What I imagined was likely nowhere near what she truly experienced.
Wait.

She can't move forward without being convinced, and she's utterly incapable of lying.
Contrary to her carefree aura, she seemed surprisingly clumsy about life.
...Right then, I felt Mr. C.B.'s gaze on me.

The fanfare echoes, and the gates fly open.
Bursting out of that dark, cramped space onto the lush green turf!
...Hnnngh!!

I know what a "Trainer" wants more than anything else.
I know it's massive achievements and a once-in-a-lifetime pride.

"Do that, and a G1 victory, a URA award, or even becoming a Triple Crown Umamusume
won't just be a dream." I heard words like that all the time. But—

She lives purely to run.
Her fundamental values are entirely detached from the rest of the world.
Huh, why?

She couldn't aim for the "G1 victories" or "Triple Crown" that trainers desired.
In that case, if the trainer could align with her values instead—

...Even so, it wasn't strictly necessary for them to share the exact same dream.
Many Umamusume sign contracts with trainers just to make their debut first.
You really are honest to a fault, aren't you? ...Fufu.

I understood what kind of scenery she was seeing.
Just imagining it made my heart dance. But—

Still, if you'd just said you understood, they might've wanted to sign you!
You're kind of, well...

Faster than the wind, faster than light, casting everything aside, forward and forward!
No one can stop you anymore, no one can hold you down...!

You're a brilliant and kind trainer, aren't you? I can tell just by watching.
You haven't done anything wrong. It's just...
To sum up the reason briefly—

...I clashed with the trainers over how to do things.
So I ended up quitting.

Picture this: you're inside a narrow starting gate,
and beyond it spreads a vast expanse of lush green turf.

......
Align with me? You?

...I was still a bit worried, but overstaying my welcome wouldn't be good either.
Just as I was hurriedly getting ready to leave—

I live alone. Right now there's nothing in the house, so...
Sorry to ask, but could you go buy some water for me...?

...Even now, I still don't really get it.
Running for the future of Umamusume like Rudolf does, I mean.

Today's turf is soft. Chilly air rushes through your body.
The girls beside you push forward one after another to secure positions, but—
Do you want to know what I see when I'm in a race?
Why can't you just listen to what you're told?

I lined up the prepared food, household medicine, and energy drinks on the table.
With this much, she shouldn't have any trouble even if she stays in bed for a few days.

Sorry about that.
Turning down your scouting offers over and over, I mean.
I just couldn't bring myself to care about G1 wins or becoming a Triple Crown Umamusume.

—Back then, I belonged to a club team they called prestigious. I was
getting trained by all sorts of famous trainers there.

Ahaha, sorry for making you walk me home.
Phew... you really saved me back there...

...Soon comes the third corner, here comes the hill!
Accelerating as your heart leaps, climbing up and flying down—the final corner!

—When I opened my eyes,
she was peering at me with an exhilarated expression.

As I recalled and pondered Mr. C.B.'s words...
I suddenly realized something.

Looking closer, not only was there no water, there wasn't a single bite of food,
so I bought various groceries, cooked for her... and ended up nursing her properly.
